dialogue.content: 今日はよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: 相談員です。よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: I'm your counselor. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: It's nice to meet you too.

dialogue.content: はじめに　年齢と性別　相談内容を教えてください
dialogue.English: To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 52歳、女性です。
dialogue.English: I'm a 52-year-old woman.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 今日はどのような　ご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: So, what brings you here today?

dialogue.content: 旦那さんが亡くなったのですが、だんだん喪失感が増してきて1人でいるのが辛いです。
dialogue.English: My husband passed away, and my sense of loss has been growing. It's painful being alone.

dialogue.content: それはお辛いですね
dialogue.English: That must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 喪失感が増えてきたと思ったのは　いつごろなんでしょうか
dialogue.English: Around when did you start to feel this sense of loss growing?

dialogue.content: 亡くなって2年目なんですが、1年目は訳が分からず過ぎていったのですが、今だんだん現実味がましてきました。
dialogue.English: It's been two years since he passed away. The first year went by in a blur, but now reality is gradually setting in.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。時間が経過していくうちに一人でいるのがお寂しいんですね
dialogue.English: I see. So as time goes by, you're feeling lonely being by yourself.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 状況を詳しく知りたいので　普段の事を　いくつか質問してもよろしいですか
dialogue.English: To understand your situation better, may I ask a few questions about your daily life?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: いつも　お家に在宅でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Are you usually at home?

dialogue.content: 働いています。
dialogue.English: I work.

dialogue.content: 働いてる時は　喪失感やさみしい気持ちは続いていらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: When you're working, do the feelings of loss and loneliness persist?

dialogue.content: 働いている時は、大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: When I'm working, I'm okay.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: では　喪失感はお家で考える時にあるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So, do you feel this sense of loss when you're at home with time to think?

dialogue.content: 夜になると、辛くなります。
dialogue.English: It gets hard at night.

dialogue.content: 独りでいらっしゃる時間が　不安にしてしまうのですね
dialogue.English: So the time you spend alone makes you feel anxious.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 何かお一人の時に　寂しい気持ちにならない対処などはされたことはありますか
dialogue.English: Have you ever tried to do anything to cope with the feelings of loneliness when you're by yourself?

dialogue.content: 今は、まだ何も考えられない感じです。
dialogue.English: Right now, I feel like I can't really think of anything yet.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 先ほど　夜お辛くなると　伺いましたが　就寝のときですか
dialogue.English: You mentioned earlier that it gets difficult at night. Is that around bedtime?

dialogue.content: 子供達が遊びに行っていない夜や、寝る時です。
dialogue.English: On nights when my children are out, and at bedtime.

dialogue.content: 子供さんと一緒に住んでいらっしゃるんですねそれは　心強くおもえます
dialogue.English: So you live with your children. That must feel reassuring.

dialogue.content: 辛くなると　どんなことをおもっているのでしょう？
dialogue.English: When it gets hard, what kinds of thoughts come up?

dialogue.content: 2人いるのですが、2人とも社会人になってるのでそこは安心しています。
dialogue.English: I have two, and they are both working adults, so I'm relieved about that.

dialogue.content: 本当にたよりにしてるんですね
dialogue.English: It sounds like you can really count on them.

dialogue.content: 今まで感じなかった孤独感が襲ってきます。後、今後1人で家族の責任を背負っていく恐怖などです。
dialogue.English: A sense of loneliness I've never felt before overwhelms me. Also, the fear of having to bear the family's responsibilities alone from now on.

dialogue.content: それは　お辛いですね　自分でなんとかしていこうというお気持ちが不安なのですね
dialogue.English: That sounds very painful. The thought of having to manage everything on your own brings up anxiety for you.

dialogue.content: 未来への不安ですかね...
dialogue.English: I guess it's anxiety about the future...

dialogue.content: お察しします
dialogue.English: I can imagine.

dialogue.content: 未来への不安は　ご家族のことだけですか
dialogue.English: Is your anxiety about the future only related to your family?

dialogue.content: 今まで旦那さんに頼ってた部分もかなりあるので、自分の事の不安もあります。
dialogue.English: I relied on my husband for quite a lot, so I also have anxieties about myself.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。自分の不安は　例えばどんな事でしょうか教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Could you tell me, for example, what kinds of anxieties you have about yourself?

dialogue.content: 老後の事が大きいかもしれません。
dialogue.English: It might mostly be about my old age.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね　夜も老後の事を考えてしまうかんじでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. Do you find yourself thinking about your later years at night as well?

dialogue.content: たまに考えますが、夜は孤独感の方が辛いです。
dialogue.English: I think about it sometimes, but at night, the loneliness is more painful.

dialogue.content: 子供さんがいらっしゃり　頼れる存在がお二人いてくれるといううのは心強く　おもいますが　いかがでしょう？
dialogue.English: Having your children there, two people you can rely on, seems reassuring—how does that feel to you?

dialogue.content: ある面では心の支えになっているのですが、頼れる存在かは...笑
dialogue.English: In some ways, they're a great emotional support, but as for whether I can rely on them... (laughs)

dialogue.content: そうなんですね　笑　孤独はお辛いとおもいますが　ご家族の存在はとても幸せだなとかんじます
dialogue.English: I see. (laughs) I imagine the loneliness is very hard, but I feel that having your family with you is a great blessing.

dialogue.content: それは本当にそう思います。
dialogue.English: I truly feel that way.

dialogue.content: 素敵ですよね　仲の良さが伝わってきます
dialogue.English: That's wonderful. I can tell how close you are.

dialogue.content: 自分達も辛いと思うのに、私を気遣ってくれる優しい子達です。
dialogue.English: Even though I'm sure it's hard for them too, they are kind children who look out for me.

dialogue.content: そんな　親思いの優しい　子供さんなら独りで将来を背負うと思わなくても　助けてくれるのではないでしょうか…
dialogue.English: With such kind and considerate children, perhaps you don't have to feel like you're shouldering the future alone. Don't you think they would help you?

dialogue.content: いかがですか？
dialogue.English: What do you think?

dialogue.content: やっぱり自分にとっては、いつまで経っても子供なので...
dialogue.English: Well, to me, they'll always be my children, no matter how old they get...

dialogue.content: 結婚するまでは、頑張らないとです...
dialogue.English: I have to keep going until they get married...

dialogue.content: 頑張る　お強いお気持ちがあるんですね。
dialogue.English: You have such a strong determination to persevere.

dialogue.content: なんだか頼りないんで...笑
dialogue.English: They just seem a bit unreliable... (laughs)

dialogue.content: そうですか　笑　親の立場で見てしまうと　そうなんでしょうね
dialogue.English: I see. (laughs) From a parent's perspective, that makes sense.

dialogue.content: よその子は、とてもしっかりしてみえます...
dialogue.English: Other people's children seem so much more responsible...

dialogue.content: 子供さんは　優しい思いやりがおありそうなので子供だと　決めつけづ　頼られてもいいですね
dialogue.English: Your children seem so kind and considerate. Perhaps you could try relying on them without just seeing them as 'children'.

dialogue.content: 今よりは　頼れるとおもうと　不安なおきもちが　楽になると思うのですがどうでしょう？
dialogue.English: If you felt you could rely on them more than you do now, I think your anxiety might ease. How does that sound?

dialogue.content: そうですね。遊びたいさかりで、外出ばかりですが...もう大人ですもんね...
dialogue.English: You're right. They're at an age where they just want to go out and have fun... but they are adults now, aren't they...

dialogue.content: お母さまの事をしっかり考えられる　思いやりのある子供さんですものね
dialogue.English: They are thoughtful, considerate children who think carefully about their mother.

dialogue.content: ご家族の絆を感じます
dialogue.English: I can feel the bond in your family.

dialogue.content: お時間が来てますが　今日はお話されてみていかがでしたか？
dialogue.English: We're coming to the end of our time. How was it for you to talk today?

dialogue.content: 子供にも、少し頼ってみようかなという気になりました。
dialogue.English: I feel like I might try leaning on my children a little.

dialogue.content: 頼ってみくださいね。また　何かありましたら　いつでもここへきてくださいね
dialogue.English: Please do try leaning on them. And if anything else comes up, please know you can always come back here.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: それでは終了しますね
dialogue.English: We'll end here for today.

dialogue.content: ご苦労様でした！
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time!
